Young, Anderson Monken, Flora Haberkorn, Eva Van Leemput December 2021 ### Abstract In this note, we first document to what extent companies are facing these supply bottlenecks and which sectors have been affected in a novel way. The benefit of this approach is that we have very timely data to synthesize information about what firms are seeing on the ground and what challenges they face. Additionally, we can differentiate firm sentiment across different industries.
